label: 1-minute VWAP estimate
source_note: Yahoo Finance unadjusted 1-minute HLC3 weighted by minute volume; an estimate, not reported trade VWAP or company issuance proceeds. Only retrieved regular-session bars are included, with no claim of full SIP coverage. Bars exclude the minute beginning at the close; closing-auction coverage follows the source's timestamps, and volume may differ from end-of-day daily bars.
